expected.project_name: Instalación Híbrida Fotovoltaica FV HIB Ferreira II

note: Verdict: 'formula declaracion de impacto ambiental desfavorable'. A photovoltaic plant to hybridise the existing PE Ferreira II, named an 'Instalacion hibrida fotovoltaica', hence hibrida (as BOE-A-2026-3880, Cartuja). mw_nominal: 38,74 MW instalada for the new plant; the 49,5 MW wind farm exists and is not assessed. hectares: 'La superficie ocupada por la PSF es de 54,14 ha'. Municipality: 'planta solar fotovoltaica en el termino municipal de Guadix'; the line municipalities are excluded. developer omitted: the request came from the Direccion General de Politica Energetica y Minas and no promoter company is named.
